question: How much will Gold Futures total price returns exceed S&P 500 Futures in these biweekly periods of Q3 2026? (Sep 21 - Oct 2)

calls.reasoning: Two-week relative return is near-unforecastable in the mean; the work is in the spread's width. Base rate over 10-day windows of gold-minus-S&P is ~0pp median with ~4pp sd; 2026 conditionally runs negative (gold +3% vs S&P +13% YTD, rising real yields with 10y >5% and a Fed that hiked 25bp on Sep 16 with ~55% odds of another in October) while the last month of realized data is symmetric and very wide. Offsetting tilts keep the median at roughly flat-to-marginally-positive: bearish gold (hiking cycle, strong dollar, corrective downtrend from the Jan $5,589 peak, weak Indian demand) vs supportive (record CB buying, ~$2bn Sept ETF inflows, first weekly gain in four weeks, oil >$100 inflation hedge, and the worst two-week equity seasonal of the year with VIX at 14.8). Fat tails are real and roughly two-sided because of the live Iran war: escalation (Hormuz, Gulf energy infrastructure) spikes gold and hits equities; a ceasefire or de-escalation does the reverse. Payrolls land Oct 2, 08:30 ET, inside the window and before the 20:00 UTC resolution, adding a final-day vol event; PCE on Sep 25 and PMIs Sep 23 also sit inside. Evidence is symmetric, so I stay close to the base rate and price the width honestly rather than the direction.

Both legs are futures, so financing cancels and the structural drift is minus the equity risk premium, about -0.2pp per fortnight; the 2026 conditional (gold +3% vs S&P +13% YTD) implies about -0.5pp per 10 sessions, and the two prior prints of this series were -3.59 and -0.318. calls.reconciliation: Three runs' dossiers agreed on every load-bearing fact of the state of the world (Fed hiked 25bp to 3.75-4.00% on Sep 16, 10y ~4.998%, gold futures ~4,424.90 and S&P ~7,650 on Sep 18, no shutdown risk in the window, payrolls Oct 2 inside it, no matching prediction market anywhere) and differed on three things. (1) The unconditional base rate: Run 3's +0.4pp median over 2024-26 versus Runs 1-2's ~0 over longer spans. No web access this run and no run actually retrieved the series, so this cannot be settled; I note it is explicable as window selection, since 2024-25 contains the gold bull leg, and all three converge on the current-regime conditional being negative. (2) The center. This is where I depart from the pool's mean: the decisive point is structural, not narrative. Both legs are futures, so the risk-free financing drag cancels and the expected spread drift equals gold's risk premium minus the equity risk premium, roughly -0.2pp per fortnight. That agrees in sign with the 2026 YTD arithmetic and with Run 3's two prior realized prints (-3.59, -0.318, uncorroborated but specific). Runs 1 and 2 centered positive on seasonality and a single +1.2% gold session, which are weaker than a carry identity. I take -0.3. (3) Dispersion inputs: Run 1 computed realized vols and a +0.42 correlation from actual closes, Run 2 assumed rho 0.1-0.2 on implieds. Realized gives 3.8pp SD, implied gives 5.4pp; implieds carry a vol risk premium and realized understates a window containing payrolls, so I take 4.4pp, inside all three runs' declared widths. GVZ level disagreement (24.98 / 26.54 / 27.4) is immaterial at this precision. Escape masses kept at ~3% each side: +-10pp is ~2.2 SD, which a Gaussian would price near 1.4%, and the fat-tailed reality of a live Iran/Houthi-Saudi conflict plus a gold tape that has already delivered multiple two-week moves of that size in 2026 justifies the uplift. No market anchor exists to blend against.

disagreements.claim: Spread SD over 10 sessions is 3.8pp (realized) vs 4.7-5.3pp (implied) vs 4.6pp
disagreements.verdict: Took 4.4pp: implieds embed a vol risk premium, realized excludes the Oct 2 payrolls event inside the window. Gives 90-10 width 11.3pp, within the 10.9-11.8 the runs declared.

disagreements.claim: This exact series previously resolved -3.59 (Aug 24-Sep 4) and -0.318 (Sep 7-18)
disagreements.verdict: Reported only by Run 3 from a local journal, not corroborated by the others and not independently checkable here. Specific enough to be credible; weighted as weak confirming evidence for a mildly negative center, not as a driver.
Unsettleable between dates but immaterial - all readings are mid-to-high 20s and the vol conclusion is unchanged.
Unsettleable between reports, and immaterial: the October FOMC (Oct 27-28) falls outside this window. Only the repricing path inside the window matters, and all runs agree it is rising.

disagreements.claim: Government funding runs to Dec 11 (Runs 1,2) or a Dec 4 framework (Run 3)
disagreements.verdict: Both put the deadline past Oct 2, so the Oct 1 shutdown right-tail is defused either way. Difference immaterial to this window.

disagreements.claim: A human market prices this contract
disagreements.verdict: Settled: no. All three independently checked Polymarket, Manifold and Kalshi; Kalshi's gold contracts are Dec-31 price ladders and annual gold-vs-silver / BTC-vs-gold return markets - wrong horizon and wrong pair. No bookmaker line. No anchor, so no blend.

disagreements.claim: The title labels this 'Q3 2026' although Oct 1-2 are in Q4
disagreements.verdict: Labeling artifact of the series; the resolution stamp 2026-10-02T20:00Z governs. No effect on the estimate.

calls.reference_class: Overlapping 10-trading-day windows of front-month COMEX gold futures minus S&P 500 futures price return, conditioned on the post-Jan-2026-peak hawkish-Fed regime (gold -22% from its record while equities held near highs, 10y ~5%)
